summary: Concorde International Group Ltd. files Form 6-K reporting the resignation of board member Ms. Sim Peng Thia, effective June 23, 2026, for personal reasons, with no disagreement with the company. This is a voluntary departure, not a forced/abrupt change. The registrant is the issuer. No deal terms apply.
